name: Say Plastics Inc
description: S.A.Y. Plastics Inc. is a custom injection molder located in Jacksonville, Texas. Its plant offers over 220,000 square feet for production and warehousing and runs 41 injection molding presses sized from 75 to 2,000 tons. The company molds engineering resins including ABS, PVC, nylon, polycarbonate and PPS, as well as polyethylene, polypropylene and polystyrene. Secondary work covers solvent welding, hot stamping, image transfer, secondary machining, assembly and special packaging, plus distribution and support for new molds and mold modifications. It supplies parts to pet products, plumbing, HVAC and automotive customers.
